entities.summary: Alexei Aleksandrovich Vasilchenko is a Kazakhstani former ice hockey defenceman. Vassilchenko previously played in the Russian Superleague for Metallurg Novokuznetsk, HC Spartak Moscow, Salavat Yulaev Ufa, HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk, HC CSKA Moscow and HC MVD. In 2008, he joined Barys Astana for the newly formed Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He played parts of nine seasons in the KHL between 2008 and 2017.
